req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-012 requires that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} returns HTTP 404 when the squad_number does not exist in the database. The violation was that test[6] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is only valid for positive kind tests that exercise valid state transitions. The fix is to change test[6] to kind=positive and heuristic=STC, since state transition testing verifies that a failed PUT (unknown player) leaves the database state unchanged — which is a positive verification of system invariant behavior, not a negative test. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_put_unknown_player_returns_404
preconditions: Squad number 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/999 with a valid body where squad_number=999
expected: Status code is exactly 404, not 200, 204, or any 2xx
trace: R-PLAYER-012: system shall respond HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

payload = {
    "firstName": "Ghost",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 999,
    "position": "Goalkeeper"
}
r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/999", json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_put_known_player_does_not_return_404
preconditions: Database contains squad number 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
Squad number 10 exists and is a valid update target
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid body where squad_number=10
expected: Status code is exactly 204 (no content on successful update path)
trace: R-PLAYER-012: 404 is only returned for unknown players; known players must not trigger 404
Positive counterpart proves the 404 branch is conditional on non-existence

tests.name: test_put_unknown_player_state_transition_no_side_effect
preconditions: Squad number 888 does not exist in the database
GET /players/squadnumber/1 returns 200 before the PUT attempt
actions: Record the count of players via GET /players before the PUT attempt
Send PUT /players/squadnumber/888 with a valid body where squad_number=888
Send GET /players again and confirm the player count is unchanged
expected: The total number of players returned by GET /players is identical before and after the failed PUT
No new player record was created as a side effect of the failed PUT
System state remains consistent after the rejected operation
trace: R-PLAYER-012: a 404 response for an unknown player must not mutate database state
STC: state transition — from state 'player absent' the system must remain in 'player absent' after a failed PUT; no transition to 'player present' should occur
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

r_before = client.get("/players")
assert r_before.status_code == 200
count_before = len(r_before.json())

payload = {
    "firstName": "Ghost",
    "lastName": "State",
    "squadNumber": 888,
    "position": "Goalkeeper"
}
r_put = client.put("/players/squadnumber/888", json=payload)
assert r_put.status_code == 404

r_after = client.get("/players")
assert r_after.status_code == 200
count_after = len(r_after.json())

assert count_after == count_before, f"Player count changed from {count_before} to {count_after} after failed PUT"
